why_trail.why: This is a MEASUREMENT + EVIDENCE-ASSEMBLY issue, not a code change. B2 asks two evidence gates (corpus/per-role-surface trends from git history; a role-competence test of kernel+fragments vs monolith on a mid-spine step) and hands the kernel-break verdict to Tommy. Repo carries no architecture map, so every structural number must be derived from the filesystem at a NAMED revision. Critical frame: two axes -- the commander is ALREADY split by MODE (1e8043a/#107), B2 proposes a split by CONTENT; and always-loaded (SKILL.md + named references/) must be measured SEPARATELY from conditionally-loaded (templates/scripts), per #393.

B2's gate is CONJUNCTIVE and gate (a) is decisive in the negative: per the confirmed spec line 77, if the corpus trend shows deletion IS getting the always-loaded role surface small enough, the break is NOT taken regardless of gate (b). Gate (a) is cheap and fully deliverable. Gate (b) cannot be run experimentally -- testing kernel+fragments needs a kernel+fragments decomposition to exist, and building it IS the break; only observational evidence (the refresh / job-file-not-agent-file relaunch, which is Assumption 1 in production) is available, labelled as such. CENTRAL FINDING already surfaced to the Admiral: the spec never defines 'small enough' (its own critic S2 said so), so the gate cannot be adjudicated on its own terms without inventing the missing threshold -- which launch-order rule 9 forbids. Report the trend, state what threshold would select each outcome, hand the choice to Tommy.

Plan frozen as a 3-gate hybrid: g1 census crew gate (walker, two separately-labelled series NARROW/WIDE, gross-not-net, blocking baseline reproduction at tag baseline/304-trend-snapshot, reviewer hand-recomputes 2 revisions WITHOUT the instrument); g2 competence reasoning gate (gate (b) is n=0 -- the treatment was never varied; ablation-arm cost recorded so the decline is attributable); g3 verdict reasoning gate plus one cold read. Pre-registration committed BEFORE the instrument exists, fixing a 5-row outcome-selection table. break-proceeds is FORECLOSED by the conjunction, so the three-outcome frame resolves to a two-way call. Expected landing: not-yet-earned, which the spec calls success.
